text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe, shrugging off widening criticism of the proposed sale of part of Hwange Thermal Power Station to a Malaysian company, has endorsed the multi-billion dollar deal and says not further negotiations will be held on the issue.
- Opposition Democratic Party leader Davison Gomo has called for extensive consultation among all concerned parties in the sale of such strategic national assets as the Hwange Thermal Power Station.

- A Malaysian cellular telephone service company, Celcom, has asked president Robert Mugabe to facilitate a joint venture with Zimbabwe's Posts and Telecommunications Corporation (PTC) in the provision of cellular mobile telephones.

- Northchart Investments Limited NTCH.Z has conditionally agreed to acquire the supermarkets, retail chains and hotel interest of Meikles Consolidated Holdings (Pvt) Limited -- a move which will see Z$1 billion being invested in Zimbabwe.

- Zimbabwe's case to the International Monetary Fund for balance of payment support money received a major boost on Monday with the signing in Washington of a Z$700 million credit agreement with the International Development Association.

- Some clerks and officers in Zimbabwe's tax department, taking advantage of a critical staff shortage, have been short-circuiting the overloaded manual assessment system by soliciting for bribes from taxpayers.
- Plans for developing Zimbabwe's agricultural sector by the year 2020 have now been compiled with the help of the Swedish International Development Agency (SIDA).
- International Business Machines Zimbabwe on Wednesday launched the first satellite-linked distance education system in the Southern Africa country.

- Preliminary results have shown that heavy pollution caused by dirty water dumped into Zimbabwe's Lake Manyame from Hunyani HUNY.Z Paper and Pulps caused the death of thousands of fish in the water body.
